components.gap: Success condition not plainly met. The finite dependent-source set is fixed (table rows D1-D21), but the promised proofs are not all supplied: for D3, D4, D5, D5a, D7, D9, D10, D13, D14, D15, D18 and D19, and for the general parts of D11, D16 and D20, the entry is 'Owed to that work', so a citation stands in place of the proof. The text itself says each owed entry still needs the named work at the pages carrying the argument and that those works are not held (exchangeability-and-predictive-induction-w02b-p15-022.tex lines 676-680 and 887-888). The survey's one evidence claim (D21, Slovic and Lichtenstein 1971) is accounted for only as 'unheld and owed'. No task, population, design or uncertainty is retained, and the finding 'stays owed' (lines 830-844 and 878-882), so the element 'empirical claims retain study/task/population/uncertainty' is not met. The claims whose dependent sources were fixed have therefore not all been authored.
